steps.speaker: Duck Fairy
steps.content: Quack quack, quack quack quack... Quack quack quack!!! (The corruption is gone, the flowers are blooming... our fairy tale book is back to the way it was!!! It's like magic!)
The little duck fairy raises a wand wrapped by fresh flowers, beats its wings, and lifts into the air. With a gentle wave of the wand, you sense something unusual gathering in the air around it.

steps.speaker: Duck Fairy
steps.content: Quack quack, quack, quack quack, quack quack quack! (Thank you, humans. And now, it's time to show you what the duck fairy's magic can do!)

With a light tap against the paper-like sky, the duck fairy traces a vast magic circle out of thin air. A warm radiance washes over you and your companions, and your consciousness begins to blur at the edges.
You know it's time to say goodbye.
Your consciousness slowly returns. The whispers of grass and trees ride in on the breeze, mingling with the gentle sway of wind chimes and the light, airy calls of birds.

Sunlight spills across the lake, setting the water aglitter. Eleven stretches lazily, her eyes still closed, then she opens them, and the sight before her stops her short. Taken aback, she raises a hand to her lips.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: ...It's breathtaking. Like some kind of spring magic.
Eleven gazes out at the breathtaking lake and the spring scenery, and something seems to stir in her memory.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I must have dozed off just now, and I had the most wonderful dream... a dream about magic.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: You were there, and so was little Hypa. We went to a fairy tale world together and helped the people there save the flowers, bring back the spring... The spring there looked just like this.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What a coincidence... sounds like we had the same dream. Did you have a good time there?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Very much so. Making flowers bloom with your own hands... it felt just like having magic.
You can't help but smile.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's because you do have magic. You've always had it.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You do. If you share the story of how this garden was brought back to life with your listeners, who knows? It just might work a little magic of its own and lift their spirits.
Eleven's eyes go wide.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I see... The listeners would be overjoyed to hear this. I'm sure it'll make their hard-earned holiday all the brighter. Right, I'll add this part to the script at once.
Perhaps it's the magic at work. Eleven, who has been walking around with a furrowed brow these past few days, now has a smile softening her features. Just then, you hear Hypatia's voice.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Has a certain Chief perhaps forgotten? There's still a whole group of people waiting on that magic of yours.
You turn around to find Hypatia holding up her terminal toward you. On the other end of the call, a noisy little mouse with purple fur is squeaking and bouncing about as if the world were on fire.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey! Chief, they just handed back the exam papers, and I passed! I'm already here, Chief, so where are you guys? Hypa, come get me! Hypa—

Her bubbly voice fills the air, and you find yourself meeting Hypatia's gaze. A smile passes between you, and in each other's eyes you find the same quiet reassurance: if the one on the other end of that call is happy, then everything you did today was worth it.
You give a soft cough to clear your throat.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You might not believe this, but I found magic here...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What? ...Magic?
You shoot Hypa a meaningful look, then deliberately keep Hella in suspense with a teasing pause.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As for what kind of magic, well... you'll just have to come see for yourself.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What the heck?! You totally dodged my question! You're the worst! Hypa, you too! Ugh, I'm done with you both... Just you wait, I'm on my way!
Hella's indignant voice crackles through the call, and you and Hypatia can't help but burst into laughter.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Eleven really got it right with that line... "Spring is in full bloom. Why not let your heart take a little trip?" Walking quietly by the water here... it feels like something inside you has been washed clean.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Come on, let's go get her! The flowers are in full bloom. Piling into the car with friends for a spring outing is something I've always wanted to try.
Sunlight ripples across your shoulders like liquid gold, and a breeze stirs the storybook left beside the bench.
With a soft, papery sigh, its fragile pages flutter open and come to rest at the very end, where the storybook's words offered to spring await.
<i><b>Spring returns to the land. The withered fields grow green again, blossoms push through the soil, and hope takes root in every heart. They all hold this truth close: spring will always come.
<i><b>And everything they share in the season of spring... that, they call magic.
